name: Grade follows Grade Interest using the client's mapping
description:
Objective: Grade follows Grade Interest using the client's mapping.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions calculator with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Bug regressions calculator.
2. Grade follows Grade Interest using the client's mapping.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Client mapping (configured app, 2026-11-27): A++ under 50, A+ under 40, A under 30, B+ under 25, B under 20, C under 15, D under 10. The seven Grade Interest options (10-50%) map one-to-one to the seven grades, so each limit is inclusive ("up to"): 50% -> A++,.
